detail.longDescription: A robot vacuum should be a simple delegation. The floor is dirty. The robot cleans the floor. I go do literally anything else. Instead, the promise of automated cleaning comes with a surprising number of supervisory responsibilities: rescue it from a charging cable, move a sock from its path, ponder why the bathroom threshold is apparently an impassable geological formation. The floor gets cleaner. I remain involved. Enterprise AI agents are roughly in the same spot. In Zapier's 2026 AI Agent
